name: Call Center Studio
description_en:
Call Center Studio is a cloud contact-centre service bringing inbound/outbound voice, digital messaging and agent operations into a browser-based workspace. Its current commercial page separates chat-only, voice-only, combined multichannel and an AI package. Those packages should be selected explicitly rather than treating every item in the broad AI/contact-centre menu as included.

For an illustrative outbound follow-up campaign, prepare an approved contact list, choose preview or automated delivery, monitor attempts and missed calls, then record a wrap-up outcome and inspect the campaign history. The newer module can pause a campaign at a configured missed-call threshold. Published prices are quote-only; the FAQ describes per-agent monthly or annual billing but uses different package names. No tenant, campaign, call, CRM, recording export or payment was tested.
description_zh:
Call Center Studio 是云联络中心服务，将呼入／外呼、数字消息及客服运营放入浏览器工作区。当前商业页区分纯聊天、纯语音、组合多渠道及 AI 套餐。应明确选择套餐，不能将宽泛 AI／联络中心菜单全部当作已含权益。

以假设外呼跟进活动为例，准备获准联系的名单，选择预览或自动投递，监控尝试及漏接，再记收尾结果并检查活动历史。新模块可在达到设定漏接阈值时暂停活动。公开价格需询价；FAQ 描述按客服每月或年度计费，但套餐名称不同。未测试租户、活动、电话、CRM、录音导出或付款。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose chat-only, voice-only or combined channels; confirm the separate AI package scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择纯聊天、纯语音或组合渠道，并确认单独 AI 套餐范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure a maximum missed-call rate and receive notifications when a campaign pauses or a list completes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置最大漏接率，并在活动暂停或名单完成时接收通知。

core_features.name_zh: 以联系人为中心复核活动
core_features.explanation_en: Review interaction history and call attempts, with agent-initiated preview calling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 复核互动历史及电话尝试，并使用客服主动发起的预览拨号。

core_features.explanation_en: Export filtered call details with an optional recording URL; a link is not an embedded audio backup.
core_features.explanation_zh: 导出筛选通话明细并可选录音 URL；链接不等于内嵌音频备份。

en: A distributed voice/digital support team evaluating a cloud workspace and carrier integration.
An outbound team that needs preview context, missed-call controls and separate attempt/outcome reporting.
zh: 评估云工作区及运营商连接的分布式语音／数字支持团队。
需要预览上下文、漏接控制以及分别报告尝试与结果的外呼团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit; not measured agent productivity, abandonment reduction or legal compliance.

API evidence boundary.en: The public integration overview describes click-to-call, screen-pop and combining CRM/ERP/report data. Exact endpoints,credentials,rate limits and delivery guarantees were not reviewed.
API evidence boundary.zh: 公开集成概览描述点击拨号、弹屏及组合 CRM／ERP／报告资料，未核对具体端点、凭据、限速或投递保证。

steps.en: Choose channels and an actual current quote; confirm account-wide plan, carrier, numbers and AI scope.
steps.zh: 选渠道及真实当前报价，确认账户级套餐、运营商、号码和 AI 范围。

steps.en: Map contact identifiers and allowed outreach, select a campaign mode, and define wrap-up codes, missed-call threshold and recovery ownership.
steps.zh: 映射联系人标识及获准联系范围，选活动模式，定义收尾代码、漏接阈值及恢复负责人。

steps.en: Test one attempt through agent acceptance, no-answer/pause handling and exported report reconciliation; separately download and reopen required recordings.
steps.zh: 测试一次尝试从客服接受、未接／暂停处理到导出报告核对；另行下载并重新打开所需录音。

items.name: CRM / ERP / reporting APIs
items.scope: Click-to-call,screen-pop and report matching described; no endpoint execution or authorization/rate contract checked.

items.name: Carrier SIP trunk / BYOC
items.scope: Existing carrier depends on SIP trunk availability or another configured connection; not universal number portability or free calls.

items.en: Current pricing and FAQ list different package families; a historical Basic/Pro/Enterprise entitlement cannot be mapped automatically to Chat/Voice/Multi-Channel/AI.
items.zh: 当前定价与 FAQ 列不同套餐系列，不能自动将历史 Basic／Pro／Enterprise 权益映射聊天／语音／多渠道／AI。

items.en: The new campaign page describes automatic pause at a configured missed-call threshold; it does not specify the calculation window or restart procedure.
items.zh: 新活动页说明到设定漏接阈值自动暂停，但未明确计算窗口或重启程序。

items.en: Call-report recording URLs do not establish complete audio retention,bulk download or restore.
items.zh: 通话报告录音 URL 不证明完整音频留存、批量下载或恢复。

items.en: The FAQ contains a compliance passage limited to 2024; it is not current independent legal or residency evidence.
items.zh: FAQ 含有效语境截至2024年的合规段落，不能作为当前独立法律或驻留证据。

pricing.billing_basis: Current packages quote-only; FAQ describes per-agent/month with monthly/annual options but uses older package names. No current amount,minimum,concurrent/named definition,usage rate or trial duration verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current page: Basic Chat-Only, Essential Voice-Only, Comprehensive Multi-Channel and AI Navigator/AI Power Pack, all request a quote. FAQ instead names Basic voice, Pro and Enterprise and describes per-agent monthly/annual billing plus one plan per account. Homepage offers a guided free demo and free-trial CTA without reviewed duration/allowance. Actual quote,carrier/number/messaging/AI usage fees and exit terms unknown.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前页：Basic Chat-Only、Essential Voice-Only、Comprehensive Multi-Channel 及 AI Navigator／AI Power Pack，均需报价。FAQ 却称 Basic 语音、Pro 及 Enterprise，描述按客服月／年度计费及每账户一个套餐。首页有免费引导演示及试用入口，未核对时长／额度。真实报价、运营商／号码／消息／AI 用量费及退出条款未知。

faq.question_en: Does a call recording URL mean the audio is backed up?
faq.question_zh: 录音 URL 是否表示音频已备份？
faq.answer_en: No. The reporting guide describes an optional URL in an Excel call report. Durable audio export,access after cancellation and restoration need separate verification.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。报告指南描述 Excel 通话报告中可选 URL，持久音频导出、取消后访问及恢复须另核。

faq.question_en: Can the current AI package be inferred from the older Enterprise FAQ?
faq.question_zh: 能从旧 Enterprise FAQ 推断当前 AI 套餐吗？
faq.answer_en: No verified mapping was found. The public pricing page uses a different package family;confirm the actual quote and included tools.
faq.answer_zh: 未找到已证映射。公开定价页使用不同套餐系列，需确认真实报价及包含工具。

sections.title_en: A cloud operation with several channel and AI boundaries
sections.title_zh: 具有多种渠道及 AI 边界的云运营平台
sections.en:
Call Center Studio presents a shared cloud workspace for inbound/outbound calls and customer messages,with reporting,quality and AI offerings around it. The homepage provides a guided free live demo and a free-trial entry point,but neither establishes a permanent free plan or trial allowances. Its broad claim of free integrations does not specify the effort or entitlement for a bespoke project.

The current pricing page separates Chat-Only,Voice-Only Essential and Comprehensive Multi-Channel packages. The first includes messaging,web/app chat,email and quality evaluation;the voice package lists inbound/outbound voice,cloud dialing,IVR and reporting;the combined package joins these areas. AI Navigator/AI Power Pack lists voice/chat bots,insights,agent assistance,accent neutralization and other AI tools. Do not assume a voice-only purchase includes all digital channels or AI services simply because they appear in the global menu.
sections.zh:
Call Center Studio 将呼入／外呼及客户消息放入共享云工作区，并围绕它提供报告、质检及 AI。首页有免费实时引导演示和试用入口，但两者都不建立长期免费方案或试用额度。笼统的免费集成主张也未明确定制项目的工作量或权益。

当前定价页区分 Chat-Only、Voice-Only Essential 及 Comprehensive Multi-Channel。前者含消息、网页／应用聊天、邮件及质检；语音套餐列呼入／外呼、云拨号、IVR及报告；组合套餐结合这些区域。AI Navigator／AI Power Pack 列语音／聊天机器人、洞察、客服辅助、口音处理等 AI 工具。不能因为全站菜单出现数字渠道或 AI，就认为纯语音购买已全部包含。

sections.title_en: Design a campaign that can stop as well as dial
sections.title_zh: 活动设计既要能拨打，也要能停止
sections.en:
For an illustrative follow-up list,first establish which contacts may be called and map their record identifiers. In the newer Campaigns module,the contact screen centralizes interaction history and call attempts,while preview mode lets the agent initiate the call when ready. Set an explicit missed-call limit rather than judging performance only by total dial volume.

The module page says reaching the configured maximum missed-call rate automatically pauses the campaign,and status notifications can announce a pause or completed list. It does not document the denominator,measurement window or restart policy. Those need tenant-specific confirmation before relying on the stop condition. An operational pause is not proof that the list meets consent rules or that the carrier will never label a number as spam. Assign a supervisor to inspect the cause,staffing and contact outcomes before resuming.
sections.zh:
以假设跟进名单为例，先确认哪些联系人可以拨打，并映射记录标识。新 Campaigns 模块的联系人界面集中互动历史及拨打尝试，预览模式让客服就绪后主动发起电话。应明确漏接上限，不能只用总拨打量判断表现。

模块页称达到设定最大漏接率会自动暂停活动，状态通知可提示暂停或名单完成。它未说明分母、计算窗口或重启策略，依赖停止条件前需以租户确认。运营暂停不证明名单符合联系许可规则，也不保证运营商永不标记垃圾电话。恢复前应由主管检查原因、人员容量及联系结果。

sections.title_en: Browser access still depends on routing and recovery setup
sections.title_zh: 浏览器访问仍依赖路由与恢复配置
sections.en:
The FAQ describes browser/WebRTC operation on cloud infrastructure and existing carrier connections through SIP trunks where supported. It also says a missed agent delivery can put that agent into a not-answering state that needs manual recovery. An agent who remains logged in may therefore be unavailable for subsequent calls. Rehearse loss of browser/audio connectivity and the return-to-service procedure.

For CRM work,the public API overview describes click-to-call,screen-pop and joining contact-centre data with other systems. These are integration intentions,not an inspected endpoint contract. Confirm which identifier links the contact,attempt and CRM outcome,what happens when the CRM is unavailable,and whether retries create duplicate follow-ups. Those are editorial acceptance questions;no authentication,webhook delivery,rate limit or write-back behavior was tested.
sections.zh:
FAQ 描述浏览器／WebRTC 云端操作，以及运营商支持时通过 SIP trunk 连接已有线路。它还称客服漏接投递后可进入需要手动恢复的 not-answering 状态，因此保持登录也可能无法再接电话。应演练浏览器／音频连接丢失及恢复服务程序。

CRM 方面，公开 API 概览描述点击拨号、弹屏及联络中心资料与其他系统组合。这是集成意图，并非已审查端点合同。应确认哪个标识关联联系人、拨打尝试和 CRM 结果，CRM 不可用时如何处理，重试会否生成重复跟进。这些是编辑验收问题，未测试认证、webhook 投递、限速或写回行为。

sections.title_en: A report export is not a complete recording archive
sections.title_zh: 报告导出不等于完整录音档案
sections.en:
The public reporting guide separates queued,assigned and answered flags. In a filtered call-detail Excel report,recording URLs are optional. That can help reconcile a specific call,but a URL does not prove that the audio itself is copied into the file or will remain accessible after cancellation. Verify required audio retrieval and retention separately.

Campaign reports distinguish attempt history from the last finish code,and IVR routing reports require logging on the relevant steps. Choose the report that answers the actual question:latest contact outcome,all attempts or a particular menu path. The manual index separates administrator,agent,supervisor,reporting and quality-control training. Only the index and text guide were read;video titles and old linked PDFs are not evidence that the newer campaign module behaves exactly like the legacy interface.
sections.zh:
公开报告指南区分排队、分配及接听标记。筛选后的通话明细 Excel 报告可选包含录音 URL，有助核对具体电话，但 URL 不证明音频已复制进文件，也不证明取消后仍可访问。所需音频取回及留存须另验。

活动报告区分尝试历史与最后收尾代码，IVR 路由报告要求相关步骤启用日志。应按真实问题选报告：联系人最新结果、全部尝试还是某条菜单路径。手册索引区分管理员、客服、主管、报告及质检培训。此次只读索引及文字指南，视频标题和旧链接 PDF 不能证明新活动模块与历史界面完全相同。

sections.title_en: Get one current quote and a service agreement
sections.title_zh: 取得一份当前报价及服务协议
sections.en:
No numeric amount,currency or minimum is published on the reviewed pricing page. Its channel/AI package names differ from the FAQ’s Basic voice,Pro and Enterprise family. The FAQ describes per-agent/month billing with monthly and annual options and one package per account,but no verified mapping to the current tiers was found. Obtain a quote specifying current package,billable agent definition,carrier and number charges,message/AI usage,implementation and support. These cost categories are procurement questions,not verified extra fees.

Cloud delivery does not establish the location or retention of every voice,recording,AI and CRM data flow. The FAQ includes a compliance passage framed through2024,which is insufficient for a current legal or residency conclusion. Review the selected regions,subprocessors and failure route under the actual agreement. Localization also requires vendor setup rather than proving every Google-supported speech language is an installed interface language.

Although titled Client Terms,the reviewed terms expressly govern the website and its materials. Actual SaaS licensing,renewal/cancellation,refunds,SLA and exit rights remain unverified. The product fits teams prepared to configure campaigns,carrier links and reporting ownership. A buyer needing an instantly priced self-service phone app,guaranteed unrestricted language support or a complete portable audio archive needs more evidence.
sections.zh:
已读定价页没有公布数字金额、币种或最低数量。其渠道／AI 套餐名称与 FAQ 中 Basic 语音、Pro、Enterprise 系列不同。FAQ 描述按客服每月计费、可按月或年度，以及每账户一个套餐，但未找到与当前层级的已证映射。报价应明确当前套餐、计费客服定义、运营商和号码费、消息／AI用量、实施及支持；这些成本类别是采购问题，不是已证额外费用。

云交付不证明每条语音、录音、AI和 CRM 资料路径的位置或留存。FAQ 含语境截至2024年的合规段落，不足以推导当前法律或驻留结论。应按真实协议核对所选地区、子处理商及失败路径。语言本地化还需厂商配置，不能认为 Google 支持的每种语音语言都已安装为界面语言。

虽然标题是 Client Terms，已读条款明确约束网站及其资料。真实 SaaS 许可、续期／取消、退款、SLA及退出权仍未核。产品适合愿配置活动、运营商连接和报告责任的团队。需要即时公开价格的自助电话应用、保证无限语言支持或完整可携带音频档案的买家仍需更多证据。
